# `tools/aiming/GlobalAim.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/aiming/GlobalAim.js`

GlobalAim.js - shared aiming helpers for player and NPC logic Pure math + ECS utilities: no rendering or input side effects.

## Functions

### `getEntityWorldPosition(ecsWorld, entityId, heightOffset = 0)`

Get an entity's world position with an optional vertical offset. Returns null if the entity or Transform is missing.

### `computeAimBetweenEntities(ecsWorld, sourceEntityId, targetEntityId, options = {},)`

Compute an aim line from one entity to another. Returns { origin, target, direction, distance } or null if invalid.

### `computeAimFromEntityToPoint(ecsWorld, sourceEntityId, worldPoint, options = {},)`

Compute an aim line from an entity to an arbitrary world-space point.
